sources.title: Real Estate Regulatory Authority, Bihar: suo motu Case No. RERA/SM/241/2018, order dated 26.06.2025
sources.supports: a property portal held to have advertised unregistered projects and registered projects without the RERA registration number; penalty under section 62

items.note: Read in a browser on 2026-10-13 (curl and WebFetch get HTTP 403). Limits: description 'less than 5,000 words' (posting guide, 2023; the unit is as printed, and the live form is behind login, so treat it as a ceiling, not a target); up to 50 photos per listing; photos JPEG or PNG, 'maximum acceptable file size of 5 MB, and a minimum of 10 KB' (FAQ). Photo rules (FAQ): photos must match the property type posted (no row-house photo on an apartment ad); photos with contact number, email ID, company or owner name, property address, watermark or website address, and 'artistic and imaginary photographs', are not uploaded; nothing other than the property's features and amenities. Guide: describe features and amenities (garden, storage, balconies, modular kitchen), society facilities and nearby infrastructure. Terms & Conditions (effective from 20 March 2026): (1) no descriptions or photographs without all rights from the owner or power-of-attorney holder, 'including from the photographer and/or copyright owner of any photographs'; (2) the advertiser must 'represent and warrant that all Properties and associated information provided by the User will be accurate'; (3) no posting under a name other than an agent 'duly authorized and engaged by the owner'; (4) 99acres may modify a listing and remove it without notice, with AI and human moderation; (5) listing videos must be original, carry no personally identifiable information of the user or agency, nothing obscene, no language detrimental to any community; (6) the 'verified' tag 'merely indicates the verification of the existence of the property' as advertised, not ownership, area or price. RERA: Bihar RERA's order of 26.06.2025 (Case No. RERA/SM/241/2018) held that a property portal had advertised unregistered projects and registered projects without the RERA registration number, and imposed a penalty under section 62 (regulator's order PDF); the rule itself is in comp:rera_advertisement_rules. Cross-reference genre:real_estate_listing.

items.note: No title length is published for Discover: the doc gives guidance only. Title rules (official doc): avoid clickbait that uses 'misleading or exaggerated details in preview content (title, snippets, or images)' or withholds crucial information; 'Use page titles and headlines that capture the essence of the content'; avoid sensationalism that caters to 'morbid curiosity, titillation, or outrage'. Image rules: large images need the max-image-preview:large setting (or AMP); name the image in schema.org markup or the og:image tag; 16x9 aspect ratio (Google may crop automatically); avoid a site logo or text-heavy image as the card image. Content can be older if still helpful; eligibility needs indexing plus the Discover content policies, which repeat the Google News rules on sponsored content, misleading previews and transparency (dates, bylines, author and publisher information, contact details). Violations can remove content from Discover and Discover surfaces such as Articles for you in Chrome.

items.note: Two Google text numbers disagree: the best-practice page suggests about 280 characters per page, while the content policy says a story may lose eligibility for richer Search experiences if most pages exceed 180 characters; write to 180. Page count: no number appears on the Google Search Central pages read today; a Google Creators guide quoted in search snippets (minimum 4 pages, ideally under 30) returned 404 or redirected to the Creators home page on 2026-10-13, so it is unverified and not a limit here. Required metadata on every story: publisher-logo-src, poster-portrait-src, title and publisher. Content policy: no copyrighted material without permission, no stretched or pixelated assets, a binding narrative from page to page, no story that needs a click to another site for essential information, no story whose sole goal is to advertise (affiliate links only as a minor part). Best practices: remove platform-specific calls to action (Instagram, Snapchat, YouTube) when repurposing, avoid burned-in text (and text in the poster image), add alt text, and for video-only stories put the exact on-screen text in the title attribute of the amp-video element.

sources.supports: older image guidance: square 500 x 500, product covers 60-70% on white, no watermarks, logos, prices or timestamps, real photos not drawings

items.note: Two title numbers exist on official pages: the 2026 approval guidelines give an ideal of up to 5 words; a 2025 help article says under 70 characters including spaces. Write to both (five words fit easily in 70 characters). Title rules (2026): describe what the product is with key attributes (material, type, model, size); no spelling errors, repeated words, several products in one title, business terms such as manufacturer or distributor, subjective words ('best seller', 'low price'), all caps (keep a brand's own caps, e.g. HP), or city / state / country names unless crucial. Specifications: one value per field, no ranges, SI units with a space ('0.5 mm'), no 'All', 'best', 'standard', 'customized' as values, no missing key specs. Description: usage, features and applications; aligned with title, specs and photos; no marketing fluff; do not repeat the title or specs verbatim; no phone number, email or website; no other products; no copied text. Photos: white or clean background, product fills 70% or more, unique photo per product, no screenshots, no partial first photo, no several products in one photo. Always give a price with a unit that fits the category. IndiaMART checks title, photo, specs, price and description for mismatch with AI and manual audits and removes failing products from category, search, product page or even the seller catalog. Cross-reference genre:marketplace_listing, genre:catalogue_copy, genre:product_description.

Rules from the category pages: upload images 'in JPEG format without any logo or watermark'; 'Do not add any partial product images' or images with any prop; a clear front image first, more than one image recommended; it is 'compulsory to add details like the price', GST percentage, HSN code and weight; 'write a brief description' using simple words.
